batch_id.description: Scope-unique identifier of the batch, assigned by the server (identifiers.adoc, record counters).

item_id.description: Batch-unique item identifier; for a finding its finding_id.

source.description: Provider, bot kind, analysis provider, or upstream server that authored the text.

fields.description: The item's structured fields (author, file, line, rule_id, domain); never free text.

text.description: The level-1-cleaned text, enclosed in the spotlighting delimiters of the validator.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the cleaned text; the key of the verdict cache.
